cases.title: Short-Form Abstract Birth Certificate Lacking Parent Information
narrative_blocks: CERTIFICATE OF BIRTH ABSTRACT - SHORT FORM.
THIS CERTIFICATE CONFIRMS THE BIRTH OF JANE ALICE SMITH ON MAY 14, 2022. THIS SHORT-FORM CARD DOES NOT CONTAIN PARENTAL INFORMATION OR PROOF OF PARENTAL RELATIONSHIP.

defect_spec.description: The submitted document is a short-form birth certification abstract that omits mother and father full names and proof of relationship required to establish parental link.

mutation_details.reason: Short-form certificate missing parental identity fields

narrative_blocks: NOTICE OF DELAYED BIRTH REGISTRATION RECORD.
APPLICATION FOR LATE REGISTRATION OF BIRTH SUBMITTED ON MAY 20, 2025 FOR BIRTH OCCURRING ON MARCH 12, 2010. CIVIL REGISTER ENTRY NUMBER UNASSIGNED PENDING JUDICIAL REVIEW.
